items.title: RWA: $365B committed vs $38B distributed — the gap that makes distribution integrity the question
items.description: Everyone quotes the tokenization market at $38B; the committed pipeline reads far higher. Council of AI's distribution-integrity axis exists precisely to answer 'is the marketed value really on-chain?'

items.title: Stanford's AI Index found a 42% error rate in AI benchmarks — here's what a measurement body does about it
items.description: The Stanford AI Index's finding that AI benchmarks carry a 42% error rate is the industry's quiet admission: evaluation is unregulated evidence. Council of AI publishes reproducible signed measurements instead.
items.canon: Measurement, not certification. Not a notified body.
